sentences.text: Nayvadius DeMun Wilburn -LRB- born November 20 , 1983 -RRB- , known professionally as Future , is an American rapper , singer , songwriter , and record producer .
Born and raised in Atlanta , Georgia , Wilburn first became involved in music as part of the Dungeon Family collective , where he was nicknamed `` the Future '' .	Dungeon Family	Dungeon Family

After amassing a series of mixtapes between 2010 and 2011 , Future signed a major record label deal with Epic Records and A1 Recordings , which helped launch Future 's own label imprint , Freebandz . He subsequently released his debut album , Pluto , in April 2012 to positive reviews .	Pluto	Pluto (Future album)
Future 's second album , Honest , was released in April 2014 , surpassing his debut on the album charts .	Honest	Honest (Future album)
